about: Style test, round two (owner, 2026-10-14): the owner's starred styles (techno-vistas) on four more frames. Frame subjects are model-drafted test prompts, labelled, never published; style prompts are round one's; no artist or studio is named. Z-Image Turbo with no references, for comparison.

styles.name: Techno vistas
styles.prompt: Detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine uniform linework, rich mechanical and architectural detail kept to the middle and far distance, vast airy compositions with big pastel skies and enormous elegant megastructures on the horizon, cel-shaded flat color with soft hard-edged shadows, clean and bright and hopeful, cinematic wide-angle perspective, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

frames.name: The corridor, three together
frames.scene: Three eighteen-year-olds stand together in a bright corridor outside a game hall just after a match: on the left the tall pale young man smiles, relaxed; in the middle the slim spiky-haired young man grins and talks with his hands; on the right the young woman folds her arms, unimpressed. Medium shot at eye level.

frames.name: The robot's menu
frames.scene: At a small table in an open-air courtyard cafe, two young men lean over a glowing menu screen held up by a little wheeled serving robot; the spiky-haired one stares at it in wonder, the tall pale one looks on, curious. The screen shows only abstract glowing shapes. Medium close shot.

frames.name: Bai: "Dreadnaught!"
frames.scene: At a cafe table a young woman pulls one side of a pair of big headphones away from her ear and shouts across to the next table, grinning, a handheld game device in her other hand; behind her, softer, two young men at the next table turn to look. Medium shot.

frames.name: The gate at dusk
frames.scene: Dusk at the gate of an open-air courtyard cafe, the lamps just coming on. The tall pale young man stands alone in the foreground looking down at a small handheld device in his hand, his thumb hovering; far behind him, the slim spiky-haired young man walks away toward a table. Wide shot.
